crossRefs.note: Therefore if I come, I will call attention to his deeds which he does, unjustly accusing us with wicked words. Not…
Whoever doesn’t receive you, nor hear your words, as you go out of that house or that city, shake the dust off your…
He who receives you receives me, and he who receives me receives him who sent me.
and he from within will answer and say, ‘Don’t bother me. The door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed. I…
Open your hearts to us. We wronged no one. We corrupted no one. We took advantage of no one.
I say this not to condemn you, for I have said before that you are in our hearts to die together and live together.
Who then is Apollos, and who is Paul, but servants through whom you believed, and each as the Lord gave to him?
Now if Timothy comes, see that he is with you without fear, for he does the work of the Lord, as I also do.
Therefore let no one despise him. But set him forward on his journey in peace, that he may come to me; for I expect him…
Working together, we entreat also that you do not receive the grace of God in vain,
As for Titus, he is my partner and fellow worker for you. As for our brothers, they are the apostles of the assemblies…
Yes, I beg you also, true partner, help these women, for they labored with me in the Good News with Clement also, and…
and Jesus who is called Justus. These are my only fellow workers for God’s Kingdom who are of the circumcision, men who…
and sent Timothy, our brother and God’s servant in the Good News of Christ, to establish you, and to comfort you…
to the beloved Apphia, to Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the assembly in your house:
as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.

translations.web: We therefore ought to receive such, that we may be fellow workers for the truth.
translations.bsb: Therefore we ought to support such men, so that we may be fellow workers for the truth.
translations.kjv: We therefore ought to receive such, that we might be fellowhelpers to the truth.
translations.asv: We therefore ought to welcome such, that we may be fellow-workers for the truth.
